game_concept: A puzzle set in The Kingdom – Market Square, a bustling cobbled market square: the royal scribe must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Variable Crates: Drag collected scrolls into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the wall banner.
theme: The Kingdom – Market Square: a bustling cobbled market square
core_gameplay_loop: In Market Square, repeat each round: Drag collected scrolls into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the wall banner. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the crate_b value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the wall banner using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The wall banner reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the wall banner is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 2 (intro tier): Variable Crates
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Variable Crates' (Week 1 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Market Square'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how crate_b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Market Square.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The wall banner reached with actions_used <= 19.
